bias.zh: 看空 · 重回 $51.9 上方，仍在 5 日均线下方

read.en: Applied Optoelectronics rose 3.9% on Nov 9 to $52.10, trading $48.32–54.03. It remains below the falling 5-day ($54.47), 10-day ($64.23), 30-day ($84.62) and 100-day ($107.21) averages and the rising 200-day ($114.73). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($62.76), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 11月9日上涨 3.9%，收于 $52.10，盘中区间 $48.32–54.03。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$54.47）、10 日（$64.23）、30 日（$84.62）和 100 日均线（$107.21）以及上行的 200 日均线（$114.73）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$62.76），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The close cleared the $50.8–51.9 resistance (Feb 11 high, Nov 6 high), now support; the $54.03 high stopped just under the 5-day. Resistance is $54.0–54.5, then $56.9–57.2 (Nov 5 high, Nov 4 low) and $61.9–62.8 (Nov 2–3 lows, SAR). Support is $50.8–51.9, then $48.3 (Nov 9 low) and $45.2–45.9. A close above $54.5 would target $57; below $50.8, $48.3.
